action.evaluate: ()=>{const a=Realm.state.adventure,text=document.querySelector('#target-state').textContent,damage=Number(text.match(/Last confirmed impact: (\d+)/)?.[1]);const summary={claimed:a.pursuit.claimed,fittings:a.pursuit.fittings,weapon:a.equipment.weapon,attack:RealmAdventure.stats(a).attack,confirmedDamage:damage,xp:a.xp,originalOrenQuest:a.starter};if(a.pursuit.claimed!==5||a.pursuit.fittings.copper_blade!==2||a.equipment.weapon!=='copper_blade'||a.xp!==0||a.starter.accepted||damage!==27)throw Error('Final full outing contract: '+JSON.stringify(summary));return summary;}
